title: Kratom (Mitragyna speciosa): FDA Regulatory Status, State Bans & 7-OH Scheduling
excerpt: Kratom remains unapproved by the FDA for any use, subject to Import Alert 54-15, and caught in a regulatory tug-of-war between state bans, Consumer Protection Acts, and a federal push to schedule concentrated 7-hydroxymitragynine. Here is what companies in the dietary supplement and functional beverage space need to track.
seo_title: Kratom FDA Status 2026 | Import Alerts, State Bans & 7-OH Scheduling
seo_description: Comprehensive regulatory intelligence on kratom (Mitragyna speciosa), mitragynine, and 7-hydroxymitragynine. FDA import alert 54-15, DEA scheduling history, state-by-state ban map, KCPA legislation, and compliance guidance.
